noise_assumptions.notes: Conservative superconducting estimates. Not used by the Task B benchmark.

design_rationale: EXAMPLE ONLY - not a recommended design. Linear 5-qubit chain with two-way links for a layered nearest-neighbour ansatz. Rx/Ry/Rz/CX are universal and match the benchmark basis. A chain keeps every qubit at degree 2 or less, at the cost of SWAPs for long-range gates such as those in QFT-3.
